UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile or active node in the Vexora network

id.description: The unique identifier, matching auth UID or assigned node key

email.description: Optional private email address linked with auth

avatar.description: URL to the user's avatar image

bio.description: Hex-encoded bio or normal description text

banner.description: URL of the custom profile banner image

location.description: Physical, digital, or neural location grid identifier

joinedDate.description: The creation timestamp when user node initialized

followers.description: Number of users following this node

following.description: Number of other nodes this user follows

isVerified.description: Flag for validated or admin nodes

followingIds.description: A set of user IDs followed by this user

friendIds.description: A set of user IDs connected as friends

Post.title: Post
Post.description: A pulse transmitted on the network feed

content.description: Main textual payload of the pulse

timestamp.description: Creation timestamp represented as a text or date string

gif.description: Optional GIF attachment URL from system

communityId.description: Associated community ID if type is community

Community.title: Community
Community.description: A localized cluster group for specialized discussion and updates

image.description: Thumbnail image of the community cluster

description.description: Statement of purpose for the cluster

ownerId.description: Auth UID who initiated the group

Story.title: Story
Story.description: A fading ephemeral text story or pulse

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A secure direct message pulse between nodes

senderId.description: The node that transmitted this message

receiverId.description: The target node that receives this message

participants.description: Array of user IDs who are participants in this chat (sender and receiver)

/users/{userId}.description: Profiles of registered nodes synced via Firebase Auth

/posts/{postId}.description: Synchronized global or community feed items
